summary: Letlow publicly praised AIPAC after a 2023 meeting, endorsed U.S. security assistance to Israel and Israel-Arab normalization, and urged colleagues to strengthen the U.S.-Israel partnership. She also voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition in education-discrimination enforcement. Both actions align with shielding Israel and reinforcing the U.S.-Israel relationship.
